doc: Lane ghost-powers: each ghost form's attack set beyond the powers.json row (the form's timing, Madness cost and the old hauler/gearbox tuning stay there). One block per ghost (tonnage, dent, kerf, ohm), each with upgrade_tier (0 = base; the per-act quest upgrades raise it later, nothing reads above 0 yet). Metres, seconds, damage in hp (a patrol cop has 1, a riot cop 2 x the pit's armour, a robot thug 6). Anchors are body-local metres (+x = facing, +y = right) until the forms lane's form rows carry them.

tonnage.doc: Tonnage (the walking stamping press; the old hauler soul): while the form is on Rivet takes armor_k of every hit (small arms spark off the plates). The press slam (melee press, wind-up = powers.json hauler.stomp_windup_s) lands press_ahead_m ahead of the facing: every car whose centre is within car_crush_m is flattened (wrecked outright), every live fighter within hauler.stomp_radius_m takes hauler.stomp_damage and is thrown. A human it kills within crush_m of the press head is flattened (signature_kills.json row tonnage_crush, weapon stomp); one killed farther out by the shockwave dies the standard thrown death (weapon stomp_wave); a ram kill throws the body aside (row tonnage_ram, weapon ram).
